description.en:
Object detection lagged behind image classification because a detector had to localize many possible objects as well as recognize them. R-CNN connected region proposals with features transferred from a large pretrained convolutional network.

The system generates candidate regions, warps each region to a fixed size, extracts CNN features, and classifies the regions with category-specific models. Bounding-box regression then refines the proposed locations. Experts generally treat R-CNN as the starting point of the modern region-based detector family. Its accuracy gains were decisive even though repeated CNN computation made the original pipeline slow and cumbersome.
description.zh:
目标检测落后于图像分类，因为检测器不仅要识别物体，还要在大量候选位置中完成定位。R-CNN 把区域候选与大型预训练卷积网络迁移得到的特征连接起来。

系统先生成候选区域，把每个区域缩放到固定尺寸，再提取 CNN 特征并用类别模型进行分类。最后通过边界框回归进一步修正候选位置。专家通常把 R-CNN 视为现代区域式检测器家族的起点。尽管原始流程需要重复运行 CNN、速度较慢且步骤繁琐，它带来的精度提升仍具有决定性意义。

role.zh: 2000 年归一化切分论文共同作者
